business.description: Kriti Nutrients Limited is a leading Indian soybean processing company established in 1995 and part of the Kriti Group. It manufactures branded refined edible oils (soybean, mustard, sunflower, groundnut) and value-added soybean derivatives and protein ingredients for food processing, pharmaceutical, dairy, aquaculture, and poultry industries.

outlook.statement: The Company is positioned to capitalise on growing demand through stronger brands, wider market access and customer-focused execution. Priorities for FY 2026-27: continue rebalancing portfolio toward consumer packs and alternate oils targeting 33-35% of overall business mix (from ~25% currently), deepen presence in modern retail formats, progress region-specific distribution and product strategies tailored to local market needs.

Global plant protein market projected to grow from US$ 24.3 Billion to nearly US$ 60 Billion by 2036, with India expected to lead expansion. India's health foods market approaching US$ 30 Billion. Government support through National Mission on Edible Oils boosting domestic oilseed production, higher duties on imported oils improving competitiveness of local manufacturers.

Expanding product choice, enhancing manufacturing efficiency, expanding distribution footprint, deepening retail penetration, strengthening channel partnerships, using digital tools for faster decisions and deliveries. Target overall capacity utilisation of 85% in FY 2026-27.

Kriti Nutrients is strengthening its position as a value-added food and nutrition company by expanding beyond commodity edible oils into high-margin soybean protein ingredients and branded consumer products. Strategic investments in product innovation, alternate edible oils, consumer-pack expansion, digital distribution and geographical reach are expected to accelerate long-term growth.
The Company is continuing making efforts for improvement of the financial results and create worth for the stakeholders and investors
